create_stats_collector: create a StatsCollector to aggregate multiple stats objects for teacher and student networks
add_stat_to_collector: add a StatsCorr or StatsHs stat object to a StatsCollector instance
compute_Hs_matrices: compute Hs and beta matrices between teacher and student networks using StatsHs
export_stats_results: export accumulated statistics from a StatsCollector as a dictionary of CPU tensors
compute_activation_correlations: compute per-layer activation correlations between teacher and student networks using StatsCorr
